strict_scale_note: Natural userspace VFS incident is well below large_system_strict padding. Profile is large_system without the strict LOC/resource gate.

root_cause_clusters.RC1_DEFAULT_ACL: Parent default ACL is not copied onto new children as access/default ACLs, and umask still subtracts.
root_cause_clusters.RC2_STICKY: Restricted deletion flag is ignored or only checks one owner.
root_cause_clusters.RC3_SETGID: New objects keep the creator primary gid and new dirs drop the setgid bit.
root_cause_clusters.RC4_QUOTA: Usage is counted in bytes, directories skip inode charge, and hard links double-count.
root_cause_clusters.RC6_ACL_MASK: Named entries ignore the mask; chmod does not refresh the group class; --default writes the access ACL.
root_cause_clusters.RC7_WALK: Path walk skips execute on ancestors and link skips dest-dir write.

defects.observable_failure: New file has no named review ACL from the parent default.
defects.partial_fix_trap: setfacl on each new file hides missing inheritance.

defects.observable_failure: New directory does not receive a copy of the parent default ACL.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Copying access ACL only still drops default on grandchildren.

defects.observable_failure: umask is applied even when a default ACL is present.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Hardcoding 0666 ignores requested mode intersection.

defects.observable_failure: --default replaces the access ACL instead of acl_default.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Writing both ACLs the same still clobbers a distinct access ACL.

defects.observable_failure: default_entries is always empty.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Printing access entries twice fakes inheritance.

defects.observable_failure: Sticky directories allow any writer to unlink.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Denying all unlinks except root breaks owner cleanup.

defects.observable_failure: Overwrite in a sticky dir skips dest ownership.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Blocking all overwrites hides the dest sticky rule.

defects.observable_failure: New file gid is the creator primary gid on a setgid dir.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Forcing staff gid globally breaks globex.

defects.observable_failure: New subdirectory drops the setgid bit.
defects.partial_fix_trap: chmod g+s after mkdir fails under a later umask/ACL path.

defects.observable_failure: blocks_used equals file byte length.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Dividing by 1024 still disagrees with blksize 512.

defects.observable_failure: 513-byte file charges one block via floor divide.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Always charging 1 block fails larger payloads.

defects.observable_failure: Directories do not increment inodes_used.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Counting only files lets mkdir exhaust nothing.

defects.observable_failure: Hard link increments inode quota.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Skipping nlink update makes unlink delete data early.

defects.observable_failure: Unlink frees blocks while nlink remains > 0.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Never freeing quota fails the last-link case.

defects.observable_failure: rename /drop/../../globex/x leaves the tenant prefix.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Rejecting all .. paths blocks valid /a/../b.

defects.observable_failure: Named user/group grants ignore the mask.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Clearing named entries instead of applying the mask.

defects.observable_failure: chmod does not rewrite mask/user::/other:: on ACL inodes.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Dropping the ACL on chmod loses named entries.

defects.observable_failure: Missing execute on an ancestor still reaches a writable leaf.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Requiring read on ancestors breaks search-only paths.

defects.observable_failure: link does not require write on the destination directory.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Requiring write on the source file blocks read-only linkers.

defects.observable_failure: --default flag is discarded before setfacl.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Parsing the flag but still calling default=False.

defects.observable_failure: Hard limit compare uses byte charge so tiny files hit ENOSPC early.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Raising blocks_hard in tenants.json papers over the unit bug.

defects.observable_failure: Directory owner cannot be distinguished from an unrelated writer.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Allowing any group member restores the original leak.
